description: Greater Abidjan flood priority models and multi-event Sentinel-1 validation: derived data and reproducible code is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. One combined reproducibility record supporting linked IJDRR and MethodsX articles. It contains derived tables, QA records, spatial model outputs, accepted Sentinel-1 event masks and the numbered Python/JavaScript pipeline. Raw third-party imagery, private historical records. Coverage: Côte d'Ivoire. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are urban flooding, Sentinel-1, flood susceptibility, exposure, vulnerability. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
